fields.statement: QA at 21c89c3b5: fresh go build -trimpath to a scratch path; in a capped scope with RHIZA_/SHIP_/REX_ unset, go test -trimpath -p 2 -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'TestCommitOnly|TestEvidenceCommit' passed (TestCommitOnlyIndexLocked 0.57s, TestCommitOnlyIndexLockedThroughout 2.13s, i.e. failing after the ~2 s bound). By hand with git 2.53 in a scratch linked worktree: a held index.lock makes update-index --add exit 128 with "Unable to create '...index.lock': File exists.", which the retry's match covers; a missing path fails with 'does not exist', which it does not match, so other failures fail at once.

QA at 21c89c3b5, capped scope, RHIZA_/SHIP_/REX_ unset: go test -trimpath -p 2 -count=10 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/^headless-run-agent-tabs$' passed (18.5s). With a temporary uncommitted edit making the fake rex create the pane worktree's index.lock (git rev-parse --git-path) before each pane and remove it 0.3 s later: -count=3 passed with the new fake builder; with the old fake builder put back it failed with 'attempt N builder ... fail (exit 1)'. Edit reverted; the script is unchanged.
